frequency_question: How often does a complex omnibus legislative vehicle successfully pass both chambers and receive presidential signature within a tight 64-day window?
membership_rule: Includes major omnibus bills (energy, farm bills, budget reconciliation, major appropriations) requiring bicameral conference or ping-pong action completed within 64 calendar days. Excludes routine single-agency reauthorizations.

cases.name: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009

provenance_note: claims 20 cases from only 5 named (4.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 5 named; believed roughly 20 instances of compressed omnibus enactment in modern legislative history.
known_gaps: Excludes minor corrections bills and non-omnibus measures.
skeleton: Legislative cycles analyzed by total elapsed calendar days from introduction of final vehicle text to presidential signature.
multiplier: 5 historical instances meeting strict 64-day compressed timeline criteria out of 20 major omnibus attempts in compressed windows.
validity_reason: Congressional procedural rules and session structures remain stable across multiple congresses.
